images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single isolated Celtic fantasy inn hanging sign for "Herberge bei Owains Anwesen", portrait 2:3 canvas, genuinely transparent background. Front-on, centered, the full wooden crossbar, two small iron hooks and hanging shield fit entirely in frame. Elegant dark walnut shield with simple gold Celtic knot border. One bold gold horse head in profile above a small crossed pair of antique inn keys, clear readable silhouette even at icon size. Minimal composition. Exact sign lettering in German, on two lines above the horse: "Owains" then "Herberge". Strict Tales of Xillia / Frieren anime art style applied to a prop: crisp expressive anime lineart, clean cel shading, soft simple stylized wood and metal textures. Warm brown and muted antique gold, no realism, no photographic textures, no painterly rendering, no background, no people, no extra scenery. This belongs in an existing medieval Celtic fantasy merchant directory and must look like a dignified traditional inn sign, not a modern logo. Render all empty space as alpha transparency.
